Lama Baali is the creator of Services At Your Door.
The project was launched on Kickstarter.
The funding goal for the project was $9,603.
The project was unsuccessful in reaching its funding goal by January 9, 2021.

fact_previews: The project is an app designed to find local services such as plumbers, electricians, gardeners, handymen, tow trucks, and painters.
The platform allows users to see available professionals, check their ratings, and view their availabilities.
Users can chat privately with service providers and book services if they are satisfied.
The platform promises no hidden fees or surprises, similar to booking through Airbnb or UberEats.
The project aims to benefit local businesses by providing them visibility when they have workers available.
